profile.headline: Software Engineer I @ MRI Software
profile.summary:
I am a recent graduate of Shawnee State University with a Bachelor of Science degree in Digital Simulation and Gaming Engineering Technology. I am passionate about creating immersive and engaging software experiences. I have acquired multiple skills in programming languages, such as Python, C/C++, and C#, and game engines, such as Unity and Unreal Engine 4.

I am detail oriented, have foresight, and am a concise communicator. I can manage multiple responsibilities and am able to reprioritize as needed. I can adapt to various leadership styles and work independently or team based.

I am most interested in an early career development program, where I can receive exposure to various areas in the industry. My goal is to pursue an opportunity in the software technology or game development fields, where I can apply my knowledge to create innovative and user-friendly solutions.

projects.title: Capstone Project
projects.description:
Collaborated with 20 fellow student gaming engineers and gaming simulation artists to create a video game called “The Olympus Trials.”
*The game is a first-person shooter set in a "techno-Roman" modernized gladiator arena. Players are gladiators fighting for freedom. They must navigate a maze and destroy power generators to reach the Minotaur boss, fighting against soldiers and mythical creatures along the way. 
*My role: AI Engineer for the game’s enemies. I helped determine the types of enemies, collaborated with peers to implement them, built and maintained AI logic, and debugged issues. 
*Programs used: Unreal Engine 4, Perforce
*How long took to complete: 3 semesters
*Where presented: Shawnee Game Conference Spring 2023, post-graduation party presentation
*Link: The Olympus Trials - https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/848xf5ibpn2yftjoka8tb/h?dl=0&rlkey=ah7zadah7qj1nwny5nbl6i1y3
